title: DW-MT324-ExportBundleManifest
group: DW Durable workspace volumes and handoff
clause: Guest outbox on the volume ridden over the warm-agent protocol; host packs a typed bundle manifest in OCI-descriptor shape; patch payload = git bundle with recorded prerequisite base SHA; blobs into CAS; SLSA-style provenance record appended to EventLedger

scope.summary:
GOAL: Build the product-handoff exit ramp: a guest agent working inside a microVM deposits its finished work (code patch, build artifacts, test logs) into an OUTBOX directory on the durable volume, and the host packs that outbox into a typed, content-addressed workspace bundle - blobs in the MT-321 CAS, a manifest in OCI-descriptor shape (P11: every entry is {mediaType, digest, size}; the manifest's own digest names the bundle; the whole structure is a Merkle DAG), the code patch as a git bundle with its prerequisite base SHA recorded (P13: git bundle verify gives a built-in promotion precondition check), and a SLSA-style provenance record appended to the EventLedger (P14: subjects = blob digests; predicate = {workspace-id, VM-id, base-image digest, worktree base SHA, MT-id}; the ledger's append-only property substitutes for DSSE signing in a local-first single-operator product). Export produces PENDING_PROMOTION state only - nothing this MT writes is authority-reachable; that is exclusively MT-325's promotion gate.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: workspace_volumes/export_bundle.rs (manifest types, outbox packer, export orchestration); warm_agent_protocol.rs gains export frames (protocol already at v2 after MT-323); guest agent implements outbox scan/stream; one migration 03NN_export_bundles.surql; tests including a real-VM export round-trip.

DETAILED SPEC:
1. Outbox convention (guest side, on the volume - never on virtio-fs, per MT-322 policy):
   /hsk-volume/outbox/<export_id>/ with export_id = UUIDv7 minted by the host when export starts; the guest writes files under that directory, then the session runner triggers MT-323's VolumeFsync (pre-export commit point) before any scan. Path rules: relative entry paths, no spaces, no symlinks (symlink entries are refused during scan - typed error), no entry above the export root (.. rejected).
2. Protocol frames (warm_agent_protocol.rs; deny_unknown_fields tagged enums WarmAgentHostFrame ~56-71 / WarmAgentGuestFrame ~75-104; 1 MiB frame cap WARM_AGENT_MAX_FRAME_BYTES line 8):
   Host: ExportScan { request_id, export_id }, ExportRead { request_id, export_id, entry_path, offset, len }
   Guest: ExportIndex { request_id, entries: Vec<ExportEntryMeta> } with ExportEntryMeta { path, size_bytes, sha256 } (guest hashes AFTER its fsync), ExportChunk { request_id, entry_path, offset, bytes_b64 }, ExportDone { request_id }
   Chunk payload cap 512 KiB pre-base64 so every frame stays under the 1 MiB cap (line 8). The host re-hashes every streamed entry and REFUSES the export (typed ExportEntryHashMismatch) if host-observed sha256 differs from the guest-declared sha256 - the guest is untrusted (TrustClass::UntrustedAgent, worktree_vm_registry.rs ~249); guest-declared hashes are claims, host hashes are truth. Rejected alternative (recorded): host loop-mounting the raw volume read-only - needs root privileges in WSL and pause/detach churn; the streamed protocol keeps the VM live and unprivileged. Streaming rides the exact same serial-socket frame transport the warm-agent protocol already uses.
3. Manifest (export_bundle.rs):
   pub struct WorkspaceBundleManifest { pub schema_id: String  // "hsk.workspace_bundle_manifest@1", pub export_id: Uuid, pub workspace_id: String, pub worktree_id: String, pub vm_id: String, pub base_image_digest: Sha256Digest, pub worktree_base_sha: String, pub mt_id: Option<String>, pub entries: Vec<BundleEntry>, pub created_at_utc: DateTime<Utc> }
   pub struct BundleEntry { pub media_type: String, pub digest: Sha256Digest, pub size_bytes: u64, pub entry_kind: BundleEntryKind, pub path_hint: String }
   pub enum BundleEntryKind { Patch, Artifact, TestLog }
   Media types (P11 shape heuristic, no OCI dependency): application/x-hsk-git-bundle+v1, application/x-hsk-artifact, text/x-hsk-test-log. Serialization is canonical JSON (serde_json with BTreeMap-ordered keys, no insignificant whitespace) so the manifest digest is deterministic; the serialized manifest goes into the CAS via put_blob and its digest is THE bundle identity.
4. Patch payload (P13): the guest creates the git bundle inside the VM on the volume (git ships in the toolchain base image): `git -c core.longpaths=true bundle create /hsk-volume/outbox/<export_id>/patch.gitbundle <base_sha>..HEAD` with the prerequisite base SHA = the worktree base recorded at workspace provisioning; the manifest records worktree_base_sha so MT-325 can run `git bundle verify` against the authoritative repo before any apply. A bundle-less export (Artifact/TestLog-only) is legal; a Patch entry without worktree_base_sha is a refused manifest (typed error).
5. Persistence + provenance, migration 03NN_export_bundles.surql:
   SCHEMAFULL semantic field inventory for export_bundles (
       export_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
       manifest_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (manifest_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
       volume_id UUID NOT NULL,
       worktree_id TEXT NOT NULL,
       worktree_base_sha TEXT,
       base_image_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
       mt_ref TEXT,
       bundle_state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (bundle_state IN ('exporting', 'pending_promotion', 'promoted', 'denied', 'aborted')),
       generation BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
       owner_account_id UUID NOT NULL, actor_principal_id UUID NOT NULL, authenticated_session_id UUID NOT NULL, access_space_id UUID NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL,
       created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
       CONSTRAINT uq_export_manifest UNIQUE (owner_account_id, manifest_digest)
   ); plus authenticated record-user PERMISSIONS and ResourceBroker exact-scope enforcement. State machine: exporting -> pending_promotion (all blobs CAS-committed + manifest CAS-committed + provenance appended, one transaction for the row flip) | aborted (any failure; partial CAS blobs are inert orphans awaiting MT-326 GC - they are unreferenced AND un-promoted, so the sweeper cannot touch them until their grace path resolves, and export retry re-uses content-addressing so re-streamed identical blobs dedup for free).
   Provenance record (P14), appended to EventLedger in the same transaction that flips to pending_promotion: subjects = [entry digests + manifest digest]; predicate = { workspace_id, vm_id, base_image_digest, worktree_base_sha, mt_id, protocol_version, exporter: "hsk.export_bundle@1" }. This mirrors the existing manifest-provenance discipline of WarmVmSnapshotManifest (warm_agent_protocol.rs ~118-136: source_binding_id + source_binding_generation + non-widening resource_scope) - exports refuse to pack without a resolvable source binding, exactly as durable restore refuses manifests without provenance (comment at ~126-128).
6. RESOURCE PRIVACY NOTE: export rows and provenance records carry the five scope columns (resource_scope.rs ~854-858), reads filter via sql_predicate (~798); the bundle's scope is DERIVED from its sources (volume binding + base image + worktree binding) via ResourceScope::derive_from_sources (~193-228): mixed-scope sources refuse the export rather than widening (HBR-PRIV-004) - a bundle can never be more visible than the least-visible thing that went into it.

STEP-BY-STEP:
1. Read warm_agent_protocol.rs frame enums + manifest provenance (~56-136), worktree_vm_registry.rs binding resolution (durable_binding ~969), MT-321 CAS API, MT-322 volume/binding API, MT-323 fsync + FLUSH_UNVERIFIED flag seam, on post-merge main.
2. Add export frames to the protocol; implement guest-side outbox scan/hash/stream in the warm-agent binary (rebuild via warm_agent_package.rs pipeline); enforce chunk sizing under the 1 MiB cap.
3. Implement WorkspaceBundleManifest with canonical serialization and a digest-stability test.
4. Implement the host packer: mint export_id, trigger pre-export fsync, scan, stream, host-side re-hash, CAS put per entry, manifest CAS put, transactional row flip + EventLedger provenance append. Export REFUSES on a FLUSH_UNVERIFIED workspace (MT-323 flag) - unverified durability must not launder work out.
5. Migration 03NN_export_bundles.surql against real SurrealDB.
6. Tests: real-VM export round-trip (guest writes outbox incl. git bundle -> host packs -> CAS blobs verified -> pending_promotion row + provenance event); hash-mismatch refusal; symlink/traversal refusal; abort leaves inert orphans and retry dedups; scope-derivation refusal on mixed sources; FLUSH_UNVERIFIED refusal.
7. Run proof targets under scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR; record measured output.
forbidden_paths: Promotion/apply logic of any kind (MT-325 owns the gate; this MT must not make any digest authority-reachable)
session_worktrees/** and any repo worktree path
acceptance_criteria: AC-324-1: Export frames exist within the v2 protocol; every frame (chunks included) stays under WARM_AGENT_MAX_FRAME_BYTES; encode/decode round-trips proven.

AC-324-2: A real-VM export round-trip works end to end: guest writes outbox entries including a git bundle, host packs them, all blobs land in CAS integrity-verified, the manifest digest names the bundle, export_bundles row reaches pending_promotion, and the SLSA-style provenance record with subjects+predicate is appended to the EventLedger in the same transaction (Spec-Realism Gate: real VM + real SurrealDB declared and required).
AC-324-3: Host re-hashes every streamed entry; a tampered-guest test (declared sha256 != streamed bytes) refuses the export with ExportEntryHashMismatch and no pending_promotion row exists.
AC-324-4: Outbox scan refuses symlinks and path traversal (.., absolute paths) with typed errors; entry paths are relative, space-free.

AC-324-5: WorkspaceBundleManifest canonical serialization is digest-stable (same logical manifest always yields the same sha256 across runs and key orderings) and records base_image_digest + worktree_base_sha; a Patch entry without worktree_base_sha refuses.

AC-324-6: An aborted export leaves only inert CAS orphans and an 'aborted' row - nothing authority-reachable, no partial pending_promotion state; a retry of the same content dedups blobs via content addressing.
AC-324-7: Export against a FLUSH_UNVERIFIED workspace (MT-323 flag) refuses; export without a resolvable durable source binding refuses (mirrors WarmVmSnapshotManifest provenance discipline).
AC-324-8: Bundle scope derives from source scopes via derive_from_sources; a mixed-scope source set refuses the export; cross-account export-row reads are denied (live two-account test).
AC-324-9: Nothing in this MT marks any digest promoted or applies any patch; grep + test prove no PROMOTED event kind is emitted from export code paths.
AC-324-10: No SQLite, no Docker/containerd deps, no --force deletes, relative space-free stored paths; proof commands run under scoped CARGO_TARGET_DIR; implementer never marks COMPLETED.

src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/worktree_vm_registry.rs (durable_binding ~969, TrustClass::UntrustedAgent in worktree_spec ~249; lands on main after WP-1 merges)
expected_tests: real-VM test: full export round-trip with git bundle, artifacts, test logs; provenance event verified in EventLedger
adversarial test: guest-declared hash mismatch refuses export; no partial pending_promotion state
adversarial test: symlink and ../ traversal entries refused at scan
determinism test: canonical manifest serialization digest-stable across key orders and runs
test: abort mid-stream leaves 'aborted' row + inert CAS orphans; identical retry dedups
test: FLUSH_UNVERIFIED workspace refuses export; missing source binding refuses export
SurrealDB test: two-account scope denial on export rows; mixed-scope derivation refusal
negative test: export code emits no PROMOTED event
implementation_notes: Field basis: P11 (OCI descriptor/manifest Merkle-DAG shape - shape only, no OCI dependency), P12 (CAS blobs plus a SurrealDB action-cache pointer layer: run-id -> manifest digest -> blob digests), P13 (git bundle with prerequisite SHA; bundle verify as promotion precondition - executed in MT-325), P14 (SLSA/in-toto attestation shape; EventLedger append-only substitutes for DSSE locally).

Trust boundary: the guest is an untrusted agent - guest-declared hashes are cross-checked by host re-hashing; the host never executes anything from the outbox; entries are opaque bytes until MT-325's gate runs its declared checks.

The streamed-protocol-vs-loop-mount decision is recorded here per [GLOBAL-RESEARCH-052]: loop-mount rejected (root privileges in WSL, pause/detach churn, second host mount path to secure); revisit only if bundle sizes make serial streaming a measured bottleneck.
Spec-Realism Gate: the round-trip proof requires a real VM and real SurrealDB; the protocol/manifest unit tests may use fakes but cannot substitute for AC-324-2.

House rules: all Rust; SurrealDB/EventLedger authority, no SQLite; no Docker/containerd/K8s deps; artifacts and CARGO_TARGET_DIR under ../Handshake_Artifacts/; disk-agnostic space-free paths; no --force deletes; implementer never marks COMPLETED.
Resource privacy: bundles inherit intersection scope from their sources and can never widen; export visibility is account/Principal-scoped end to end.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend export MT; pending-export and bundle states surface to the operator in MT-327. Every export decision is reconstructable from export_bundles rows + EventLedger provenance records.

target_entries: Workspace handoff > Outbox convention (/hsk-volume/outbox/<export_id>/, what agents put where, path rules)
Workspace handoff > Bundle manifests (entry kinds, media types, manifest digest as bundle identity)
Workspace handoff > Provenance records (what the EventLedger entry contains, why exports are pending until promoted)

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.note: Export lifecycle FR kinds are added centrally in MT-327; until then export_bundles state transitions + EventLedger provenance records are the reconstruction surface. Record DEFERRED-to-MT-327.
Emit diagnostic events on hash-mismatch refusal, scan refusal, and abort via the open diagnostic-event API if present; otherwise DEFERRED-with-reason.

Export streaming is host-driven over the existing serial transport with per-frame progress; a hung stream is visible as a stalled 'exporting' row plus protocol timeouts - liveness capture adds no additional evidence.

risk_if_missed: Finished agent work stays trapped inside VM volumes with no typed, verifiable way out: handoff degenerates to ad-hoc file copying with no integrity chain, no provenance, no promotion precondition - and MT-325/326 have neither manifests to gate nor a digest graph to fence and collect.

risks: RISK-1: A compromised or buggy guest declares hashes that do not match streamed bytes, or streams symlink/traversal entries, smuggling unintended content into the CAS under trusted-looking digests.
RISK-2: Manifest serialization is non-canonical, so the same logical bundle yields different digests across runs - breaking dedup, provenance lookups, and MT-325's re-hash gate.
RISK-3: A crash mid-export leaves a half-packed bundle that later logic (or an operator) mistakes for complete, promoting truncated work.
RISK-4: The export path quietly becomes a promotion path (writes an authority-reachable state), collapsing the two-phase handoff and bypassing MT-325's verification.
RISK-5: A bundle assembled from mixed-scope sources (e.g. a shared base image row and a private volume) widens visibility beyond the narrowest source.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): host-side re-hash of every entry with typed refusal; symlink/traversal rejection at scan; adversarial tests for both are named regressions.
CTRL-2 (RISK-2): canonical JSON serialization with a digest-stability test across shuffled construction orders; manifest digest is computed only from the canonical bytes placed in CAS.

CTRL-3 (RISK-3): pending_promotion is reachable only via the single transaction that requires all blobs + manifest committed and provenance appended; abort is the only other exit; fault-injection test proves no third state.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): export code structurally cannot emit PROMOTED (grep proof + test); bundle_state 'promoted' is writable only by MT-325's gate module.
CTRL-5 (RISK-5): scope derivation via derive_from_sources refuses mixed scopes; refusal test is a named regression.

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
